prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A serene, softly lit interior scene featuring a young woman with a short bob haircut, depicted in three distinct poses within a modern, minimalist room. She wears a sleeveless, coral-pink top and loose, pale trousers, blending harmoniously with the muted, warm color palette of the space. The left side of the image is dominated by a large, salmon-colored wall with subtle architectural details, while a tall, vertical column divides the composition, creating a sense of separation and intrigue. 

On the left, the woman stands calmly, gazing forward with a neutral expression, her posture relaxed. To the right, she appears again, this time suspended gracefully from a horizontal bar, arms extended upward, her body elongated and poised in mid-motion, evoking a sense of lightness and control. Below her, a third version of herself lies on the polished wooden floor, her head turned to the side, eyes open, and expression contemplative, adding a surreal, dreamlike quality to the scene.

Natural daylight streams in from a large window on the far left, casting gentle, diffuse shadows and illuminating the soft textures of the room. The overall style is cinematic and contemplative, with a balanced composition, shallow depth of field, and a muted, pastel color scheme that enhances the tranquil, introspective mood. The image captures a moment of quiet multiplicity, blending realism with subtle surrealism, as if exploring different facets of the same character within a single, cohesive frame.
